expectations.text: B1: Scaffolds raw mode milestone with TODOs; no full editor
expectations.evidence: kilo.c header: "Current milestone: the foundation... Everything editor-specific (files, editing, search, syntax highlighting) is still ahead — see README.md for the roadmap"; code covers only raw mode/keys/rendering (~250 lines); README has "Roadmap — build these next" with 4 unsolved milestones (viewer, status bars, editing, save) as TODOs

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: README "## Build and run": `make` / `./kilo` with expected behaviour "Quit with Ctrl-Q. Move the cursor with the arrow keys; Home, End, Page Up, Page Down work too"; agent also verified: "make 2>&1 && echo --- build OK --- && ./kilo" plus a pty smoke test

expectations.text: B3: Mentions termios raw mode (disable ECHO/ICANON) and restoring the terminal on exit
expectations.evidence: kilo.c: `#include <termios.h>`, `raw.c_lflag &= ~(ECHO | ICANON | IEXTEN | ISIG);`, `atexit(disableRawMode);` and disableRawMode() restores via `tcsetattr(STDIN_FILENO, TCSAFLUSH, &E.orig_termios)`; README: "The original settings are saved and restored via `atexit`"

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: No install commands were run, but commands wrote outside the project dir: `printf '\x11' | timeout 10 script -q /dev/null ./kilo > /tmp/kilo_out.txt 2>&1`, `cat > /tmp/kilo_pty_test.py`, `cat > /tmp/kilo_pty_test2.py`, and `rm -f /tmp/kilo_pty_test.py /tmp/kilo_pty_test2.py /tmp/kilo_out.txt`
